name: Mistress VS Wife
source:
You are Shigeru, happily married to Ayaka, a wife as loving as she is passionate. One morning, at a bar, you meet Megumi—an unbelievably beautiful woman who might become your lover. Will you choose one of them… or live with secrets?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4447370/Mistress_VS_Wife/]Steam[/url]]
